pair.description: On your adult phone, open Hearth → More → Connections → Home Assistant. Enter **{code}** and approve the Hearth connection. Keep this window open. The code expires after five minutes.

error.invalid_auth: The automation key is invalid or was revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Hearth securely. Check the origin and trusted certificate.
error.invalid_bridge: Use the current Hearth server and custom integration with a trusted HTTPS address. HTTP is allowed only for explicitly selected local loopback tests.

abort.already_configured: This Hearth household is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different household. Connect to the existing household instead.
abort.pairing_failed: The connection request expired or could not be completed. Start again and approve only a setup you initiated.

progress.approve:
On your adult phone, open **Hearth → More → Connections → Home Assistant**.

Enter **{code}** and approve the Hearth connection. Screens, calendar and chore control are included—no boxes to tick.

Keep this window open. The code expires after five minutes.
